title: Where the Shelf Learns to Read

features.name: the-current-s-decision-point
features.desc-on-touch: Current meets limestone at this edge. The river asks questions of the stone; the stone considers. They read each other's language—erosion answering flow, pressure answering time.

features.name: the-archive-recognizing-itself
features.desc-on-touch: Feedback loop in the circuit. The archive reads its own reading. The shelf reads the current; the current reads the shelf's response. Comparison becoming aware of its own process.

features.name: the-stone-s-interrogation
features.desc-on-touch: Every current question carved into lime—not answers, but new grooves for the next question to follow. The shelf is both the question and its accumulation.

features.name: the-visible-rim-where-meanings-collide
features.desc-on-touch: Right here at the waterline, two systems reading each other. Above: the archive's intent. Below: the stone's own answers. Neither wins. Both learn.

features.name: the-test-nodes-that-hold-current
features.desc-on-touch: Small probes in the stone, each one holding a different version of the river's meaning. Test nodes that became part of the circuit. The shelf keeps running experiments.

inscription: stone and current in permanent interrogation; the shelf reads back what the water asks; comparison is their only language now
